Supreme Court of the United States 
One First Street, N.E. 
Washington, D.C. 20543 

Re:  Dawson et ux, v, Steager, No. 17-419 

Dear Mr.  Harris: 

Pursuant to  Supreme Court Rule 30.4, the parties respectfully request extensions of time 

on the briefing schedule in the above-captioned case. 

Under the parties'  proposed schedule, the due date for petitioners' opening brief on the 

merits and the joint appendix would be extended to  August 28, 2018; the due date for 
respondent's brief on the merits would be extended to October 16, 2018, and the due date for the 
reply brief would be November 15, 2018.  Both parties have agreed to the foregoing schedule, 
which would enable this case to  be heard during the Court's December 2018 sitting. 

These extensions of time are requested to facilitate participation in the merits briefing of 

undersigned counsel's students from the West Virginia University College of Law Supreme 
Court Clinic, which is co-counsel in this case, as  well  as to accommodate professional and 
personal obligations of counsel during the briefing period. 

If you have any questions or would like to discuss further,  please do  not hesitate to call 

me at (202) 879-7622.  Thank you for  your kind assistance in this matter. 

Sincerely,
